content.short: Bitspawn links competitive gaming with NFTs in a decentralized structure and uses the SPWN token for rewards, plus Bitspawn.gg for tournaments and communities.
content.description: Bitspawn connects esports competition with NFTs within a decentralized structure. The SPWN token powers rewards and progression-based mechanics that can be integrated into games. Bitspawn runs Bitspawn.gg, a network where gamers can host and join tournaments, climb leaderboards, and build communities.
